title: The Rebels are found!
description: Frustrated at his failure to capture Captain Solo and Princess Leia, Darth Vader assembles a foul crew of intergalactic bounty hunters in an intensified effort to nab the fugitives. One of these hunters, Boba Fett, is shrewd enough to track the Millennium Falcon as it heads for Bespin's Cloud City, where Solo hopes he'll receive ship repair assistance from his old buddy Lando Calrissian. Meanwhile, Luke has learned much from Master Yoda on Dagobah, but is still having trouble mastering his emotions. Concern for imperiled friends seems to be cloudin his judgment...
